epics.title: Resolve task status mismatch between internal system and GitHub
epics.jtbd: When a system operator relies on the internal status of a task, I want it to accurately reflect the actual state on GitHub (e.g. PR closed without merge), so that tasks are not falsely marked as done when their changes were never merged.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of task status mismatches (internal done vs GitHub unmerged) to 0
requirements: R1: Identify the root cause of why task 0bcb9d29-ad04-4c30-8448-e3cbacf70c4f is marked done internally when its PR#53 closed without merge.
R2: Implement a fix in the existing code to correctly sync or update the internal task status based on the actual GitHub PR closure status.

slices.title: Fix GitHub PR status reconciliation to prevent false done states
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status synchronization for this epic, I want to ensure the reconciliation logic correctly distinguishes between a merged PR and a closed-but-unmerged PR, so that the internal task status correctly aligns with reality.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with an associated PR on GitHub,
When the PR is closed without being merged,
Then the internal task status must not transition to 'done'
Given the reconciliation task runs,
When it detects a mismatch (task done but PR unmerged),
Then it correctly updates the internal task state to reflect the unmerged PR.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive 'done' tasks due to unmerged PRs to 0
